funding_notes: Verified domain kallmorris.com; Kall Morris Inc (KMI), Marquette, Michigan, founded 2019, works on space-debris removal and relocation (REACCH grappler, Laelaps spacecraft; REACCH flew to the ISS on SpaceX CRS-31 in Nov 2024). In Nov 2023 KMI announced $5M in combined funding. Payload breaks this down as about $4.25M in SpaceWERX/AFWERX STTR/SBIR Phase II awards plus $750,000 from a closed pre-seed and seed round. Michigan Rise Pre-Seed Fund III led the pre-seed (first invested in 2021), and MSU Research Foundation's Red Cedar Ventures is also a backer. SEC Form D filings show the private money was raised through non-priced instruments: about $258K of debt-type securities (Jul 2021) and SAFEs of $215K (Mar 2023), $180K (Jul 2023) and $140K (Dec 2024), roughly $793K in total. The 'seed' was SAFE-based with no public priced seed round, so status is pre-seed/angel-only. amount_raised uses the company-reported $750K. Grants listed are SBIR/STTR (non-dilutive), and KMI also cites a partnered NASA SBIR Phase II.
